info.title: monorepo
info.description: Synthetic monorepo overlay manager — rewrites PackageReferences to ProjectReferences for sibling repos without modifying any leaf repo.

options.name: --help
options.description: Show help and usage information

options.name: --version
options.description: Show version information

commands.name: init
commands.description: Discover repos under --backend, write monorepo.json, and generate the MSBuild overlay.

options.name: --backend
options.description: Path to the backend root directory (contains all leaf repos).

options.name: --overlay
options.description: Directory where monorepo.json and the overlay/ folder will be written. Defaults to the current directory. [default: <path>]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be written without touching the filesystem. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Log every csproj scanned. [default: False]

options.name: --force
options.description: Overwrite an existing monorepo.json. Normally 'init' refuses and tells you to use 'generate --refresh' so manual Enabled=false overrides are preserved. [default: False]

commands.name: generate
commands.description: Regenerate the MSBuild overlay from monorepo.json (optionally re-scanning repos first).

options.name: --refresh
options.description: Re-scan repos and update monorepo.json before regenerating the overlay. [default: False]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be written without touching the filesystem. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Log every csproj scanned (only meaningful with --refresh). [default: False]

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to monorepo.json. Defaults to the first monorepo.json found by walking up from the current directory.

commands.name: on
commands.description: Create the .monorepo-active sentinel to enable the MSBuild overlay.

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to monorepo.json. Defaults to walk-up from CWD.

commands.name: off
commands.description: Remove the .monorepo-active sentinel to disable the MSBuild overlay.

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to monorepo.json. Defaults to walk-up from CWD.

commands.name: status
commands.description: Show overlay state, active mappings, exempt repos, and disk drift.

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to monorepo.json. Defaults to the first monorepo.json found by walking up from the current directory.

commands.name: enable
commands.description: Set Enabled=true for the given package mapping.

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to monorepo.json. Defaults to walk-up from CWD.

commands.name: disable
commands.description: Set Enabled=false for the given package mapping.

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to monorepo.json. Defaults to walk-up from CWD.

commands.name: cpm
commands.description: Consolidate PackageReference versions into Directory.Packages.props (Central Package Management). Strips Version attributes from all affected csprojs. One-way migration — Directory.Packages.props applies unconditionally, independent of the monorepo sentinel.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would change without modifying any file. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Log each package version found per csproj. [default: False]

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to monorepo.json. Defaults to walking up from CWD.

commands.name: release
commands.description: Prepare a release for one or more managed repos: bumps version, writes CHANGELOG.md, creates a git tag.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Path of the target repo relative to backendRoot (e.g. 'core/common'). Defaults to all repos.

options.name: --bump
options.description: Version bump: auto (derive from commits), major, minor, or patch. [default: auto]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print release notes and next version; do not write CHANGELOG.md or create a tag. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show each commit parsed. [default: False]

options.name: --tag-format
options.description: Tag name template. Supports {version} and {repo} placeholders, e.g. 'v{version}' (default), '{repo}/v{version}', 'release-{version}'. [default: v{version}]

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to monorepo.json.

commands.name: clean
commands.description: Delete bin/ and obj/ build artifact directories from all repos and the overlay directory.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be deleted without removing anything. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: List every directory as it is deleted. [default: False]

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to monorepo.json. Defaults to walking up from CWD.

commands.name: bump
commands.description: Create a git tag for the next version without writing CHANGELOG.md.

commands.name: patch
commands.description: Bump the patch version component and create a git tag.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Path of the target repo relative to backendRoot. Defaults to all repos.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print next version without creating a tag. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show current and next tag for each repo. [default: False]

options.name: --tag-format
options.description: Tag name template. Supports {version} and {repo} placeholders. [default: v{version}]

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to monorepo.json.

commands.name: minor
commands.description: Bump the minor version component and create a git tag.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Path of the target repo relative to backendRoot. Defaults to all repos.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print next version without creating a tag. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show current and next tag for each repo. [default: False]

options.name: --tag-format
options.description: Tag name template. Supports {version} and {repo} placeholders. [default: v{version}]

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to monorepo.json.

commands.name: major
commands.description: Bump the major version component and create a git tag.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Path of the target repo relative to backendRoot. Defaults to all repos.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print next version without creating a tag. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show current and next tag for each repo. [default: False]

options.name: --tag-format
options.description: Tag name template. Supports {version} and {repo} placeholders. [default: v{version}]

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to monorepo.json.

commands.name: clone
commands.description: Clone all repos listed in monorepo.json that are missing from the backend root. Skips repos that are already present or have no URL recorded.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would be cloned without running git. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Show git clone output for each repo. [default: False]

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to monorepo.json. Defaults to walking up from CWD.

commands.name: changes
commands.description: Show 'git status --short' for every repo. Clean repos are hidden unless --all is passed.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Path of the target repo relative to backendRoot. Defaults to all repos.

options.name: --all
options.description: Also list repos with no changes (clean). [default: False]

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to monorepo.json. Defaults to walking up from CWD.

commands.name: exec
commands.description: Run an arbitrary command in every repo. Repos that produce no output are hidden unless --all is passed.

options.name: --repo
options.description: Path of the target repo relative to backendRoot. Defaults to all repos.

options.name: --all
options.description: Show a header for every repo, even those that produce no output. [default: False]

options.name: --config
options.description: Explicit path to monorepo.json. Defaults to walking up from CWD.

arguments.name: COMMAND
arguments.description: Command and arguments to run in each repo (pass after --).
